## Count this Mac once a day, if you agree
From the second day you use Astronomical, the chat window asks once, "May this Mac be counted?", and shows the exact line this Mac would send, such as `Astronomical 0.2.127 · macOS 27.2 · Apple M5 Pro · 48 GB`.
- **Nothing is sent unless you choose "Count this Mac".** "No thanks" is final. - **One line a day,** with the app version, macOS version, chip and memory, and no identifier, so one day's line cannot be linked to another's. - **Turn it on or off** under "What leaves this Mac" in Settings, which also shows when it last went.
## Clearer failures
A model whose files are damaged now says so in plain words, "This model's files are damaged or incomplete. Remove the model and download it again.", instead of "The engine stopped answering".
## Fixes
- "Send reports like this without asking" and the problem report choice in Settings now save from the chat window. - Only the chat window, Observatory and tools can change sharing choices or send a report; other pages on this Mac are refused.
## Compatibility
- Existing settings load unchanged. - Conversations, downloaded models and every setting are kept. - macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
Signed with the project's Developer ID, notarized and stapled by Apple.
